dialogue.origin: こんにちはよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Hello, thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: お願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 少し早いですが、始めてもよろしいでしょうか勿論、時間どうりでも、構いません
dialogue.content: It's a little early, but would it be alright to start now? Of course, we can wait for the scheduled time if you prefer.

dialogue.origin: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.content: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.origin: それでは、始めます
dialogue.content: Alright then, let's begin.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは相談員です今日は、ご相談に来ていただき、ありがとうございますよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: お願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 今日は、どのようなご相談で、お越しいただきましたか
dialogue.content: What brings you in for a consultation today?

dialogue.origin: 父親とのことで悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I'm having some trouble with my relationship with my father.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 始めに、年齢、性別、何とお呼びしたらよいか、教えていただきますか
dialogue.content: To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like me to call you?

dialogue.origin: 40代　女性　くる、です
dialogue.content: I'm in my 40s, female, and you can call me Kuru.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただき、ありがとうございますくるさんですね
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that with me. Kuru, is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お悩みのことについて、もう少し、教えていただけますか
dialogue.content: Could you tell me a bit more about what's troubling you?

dialogue.origin: 最近、父と私の関係について、考える事が多くなりました
dialogue.content: Lately, I've been thinking a lot about my relationship with my father.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねどのようなことを、考えるのですか
dialogue.content: I see. What kinds of things have you been thinking about?

dialogue.origin: 父とは、合わない、いい加減なとこが、嫌いだな、って気づきました
dialogue.content: I’ve realized we don’t get along—I really dislike how irresponsible he can be.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・くるさんとは、合わないと思われたのですね
dialogue.content: I see... so you feel that you and he are not compatible.

dialogue.origin: 毎日毎日いろいろあって、
dialogue.content: There are so many things, every single day...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: どのようなことが、あるのですか
dialogue.content: What kinds of things happen?

dialogue.origin: いっぱいありすぎて、、、まー
dialogue.content: There are just too many to count... well...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・お困りなんですね
dialogue.content: I see... It sounds like you're having a difficult time.

dialogue.origin: 困ってるってのとはちと、違うかも
dialogue.content: It might not exactly be that I'm troubled, perhaps.

dialogue.origin: いっぱいありすぎるのも、嫌ですよね
dialogue.content: Having too many things to deal with can be overwhelming, can't it?

dialogue.origin: とにかく
dialogue.content: Anyway...

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: 片付けられないとか、指摘しても、先送りばかり
dialogue.content: He can't clean up, and even when I point it out, he just keeps procrastinating.

dialogue.origin: 要するに
dialogue.content: In short...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 優柔不断なんですよね
dialogue.content: He's so indecisive.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・それは、戸惑われますよね
dialogue.content: I see... That must be confusing for you.

dialogue.origin: 気になりますね
dialogue.content: It’s understandable that would bother you.

dialogue.origin: まー呆れるかな
dialogue.content: Well, I'm more exasperated, I guess.

dialogue.origin: 決められない人、
dialogue.content: A person who can't make decisions...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・一緒にいると、お辛いですよね
dialogue.content: I see... It must be difficult to be around him.

dialogue.origin: 家出て、独立しようかと思います
dialogue.content: I'm thinking of moving out and living on my own.

dialogue.origin: そっか・・そこまで、切羽詰まっているのですね
dialogue.content: I see... so you're feeling that pressed.

dialogue.origin: どうしようかな、、、
dialogue.content: I wonder what I should do...

dialogue.origin: 優柔不断、決められない、具体的には、どんなことですか
dialogue.content: You mentioned he's indecisive and can't make decisions. Could you give me a specific example?

dialogue.origin: まずは、片付ける事はずっと先送り、小さい事も全部そう。
dialogue.content: For starters, he always postpones cleaning up, and it's the same with every little thing.

dialogue.origin: 自分の事も、みんな
dialogue.content: Even things about himself—everything.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですか・・すべてを、先送りしてしまうのですね困ってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: Is that so... He postpones everything. That must be very trying for you.

dialogue.origin: 呆れますね
dialogue.content: It's exasperating.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね…呆れるほど、ひどいのですね
dialogue.content: I see... so it's bad enough to be exasperating.

dialogue.origin: くるさんは、その時、どうされていますか
dialogue.content: Kuru, what do you do in those situations?

dialogue.origin: あんまり繰り返してるから、最近では、半ば諦めてます
dialogue.content: He does it so often that lately, I've half given up.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 嫌になってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: It can really make you fed up, can't it?

dialogue.origin: 話にならないんです
dialogue.content: There's no point in talking to him.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねそれは、腹が立ちますよねお父様は、何度も繰り返して、その後、どうなるのですか
dialogue.content: I see. That must make you angry. What happens after your father repeats this behavior?

dialogue.origin: 結局、何もきめきれないから、弟を当てにしたり、
dialogue.content: In the end, since he can’t decide anything, he relies on my younger brother, or...

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: だけどそれはいつも流されて放置してるだけで、結果何も動く事はない
dialogue.content: But he just lets things slide and leaves them, so in the end, nothing ever gets done.

dialogue.origin: 弟さんに、手伝ってもらっているのですね
dialogue.content: So your younger brother helps him out, then?

dialogue.origin: いえ、弟は県外にいて、
dialogue.content: No, my brother lives in another prefecture, and...

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: Oh, I see.

dialogue.origin: いずれはなんとかしてくれるだろーなんて思ってるだけ
dialogue.content: He just thinks that my brother will eventually take care of it somehow.

dialogue.origin: 弟さんを期待しているのですか？
dialogue.content: So he's counting on your brother?

dialogue.origin: そうですねだけど何も具体的なものはない
dialogue.content: That's right, but there's nothing concrete.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ご家族は、何人ですか
dialogue.content: How many people are in your family?

dialogue.origin: この4人です
dialogue.content: The four of us.

dialogue.origin: 母も入れて
dialogue.content: Including my mother.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: お母さんは、そのような時に、どうしていますか
dialogue.content: What does your mother do in those situations?

dialogue.origin: いつものことだし、特に何も口出ししてはきません
dialogue.content: She says it's just how he always is, and doesn't really say anything.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねお母さんと、お父さんは、仲はいかがですか
dialogue.content: I see. And how is the relationship between your mother and father?

dialogue.origin: 母は、父のことはわかりきつてるから、私の愚痴は少しは聞いてくれるけど、それなりに受け止めてるのでしょう
dialogue.content: My mother knows what my father is like, so she listens to some of my complaints, and I guess she accepts things as they are.

dialogue.origin: 良くも悪くもないかな
dialogue.content: It’s neither good nor bad, I suppose.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・お母さんは、くるさんの愚痴を受け止めてくれるのですねそれは、少しは安心でしますよね
dialogue.content: I see... So your mother listens to your complaints. That must be a bit of a relief for you.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。まあ、愚痴は小出しにしてはいます、
dialogue.content: Yes. Well, I only vent to her in small bits.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・愚痴を少しでも吐き出せるのなら、少しは、助かりますよね
dialogue.content: I see... But being able to vent even a little must help, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, it does.

dialogue.origin: お父さんと、お母さんの仲は、良いですか
dialogue.content: Is the relationship between your father and mother good?

dialogue.origin: 良くも悪くもなく、こんなもんじゃないかな、と思います
dialogue.content: Not particularly good or bad; I think that’s just how it is.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ここで、今までのお話をまとめさせていただいても、よろしいですか
dialogue.content: At this point, would it be alright if I summarized what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: くるさんは、お父さんが、優柔不断で、合わなくて嫌だと思っているのですね毎日いろいろあって、困っています家から、出たいと思うほどですそして
dialogue.content: Kuru, you feel that your father is indecisive, that you don't get along with him, and you dislike that. You're struggling with various things every day, so much so that you want to move out. And...

dialogue.origin: お父さんと、お母さんの仲もまあまあで、お母さんは、くるさんの愚痴を聞いてくれます。それは、心が救えますよね
dialogue.content: Your parents' relationship is so-so, and your mother listens to your complaints. That must provide some emotional relief.

dialogue.origin: いかがでしょうか
dialogue.content: Does that sound about right?

dialogue.origin: そうですね考えてみれば
dialogue.content: Yes, now that you mention it.

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: お母さんは、家族をまとめようと努力をしていると思いますが、いかがですか
dialogue.content: I imagine your mother is trying to hold the family together. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 努力っていうか、波風大きくしたくないんだろうね、疲れるだろうし
dialogue.content: Rather than “making an effort,” I think she just doesn’t want to rock the boat—it would be exhausting.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 家族をなんとかしようと、お母さんも、考えていると思います
dialogue.content: I believe your mother is also thinking about how to manage the family situation.

dialogue.origin: くるさんも、お父さんのことを、何とかしたいとお考えなんですよね・・・でも、家を出ていきたいほど、お辛いのですね
dialogue.content: And Kuru, you also want to do something about your father... but it's so difficult that you want to move out.

dialogue.origin: 毎日、だましだまし、やってきてる感じかな
dialogue.content: Every day feels like I’m just getting by, kind of muddling through.

dialogue.origin: だけど
dialogue.content: But...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・様子を見て、様子を見て、何ですね
dialogue.content: I see... You've been waiting and seeing, just observing the situation.

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あのひとは、変わる事はないのでしょうからね
dialogue.content: That man is probably never going to change.

dialogue.origin: くるさんが、そう思われるのは、当然のことだと思います
dialogue.content: I think it's completely natural for you to feel that way, Kuru.

dialogue.origin: やっぱりそうですよね
dialogue.content: I thought so, yes.

dialogue.origin: くるさんも、おとうさんのことで、いつも悩み、今まで、頑張ってこられましたよね
dialogue.content: You've always been worried about your father, and you've been trying so hard all this time.

dialogue.origin: くるさんは、優しい人ですね
dialogue.content: You are a very kind person, Kuru.

dialogue.origin: そうかな
dialogue.content: Do you think so?

dialogue.origin: いつもイライラしてる
dialogue.content: I’m always irritated.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうだと思います
dialogue.content: Yes, I do think so.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・腹が立ちますものね
dialogue.content: I see... It's only natural to get angry.

dialogue.origin: そんな自分にもイライラしてる
dialogue.content: I get irritated with myself for feeling that way, too.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・痛いほど、よくわかります
dialogue.content: I can imagine... I understand that feeling all too well.

dialogue.origin: くるさん、お父さんへの思いと、家を出ていきたいという思い、お母さんにお話ししたことは、ありますか
dialogue.content: Kuru, have you ever talked to your mother about your feelings towards your father and your desire to move out?

dialogue.origin: 話した事はないけど、父への当たりで、わかってはいると思います
dialogue.content: I haven't told her directly, but I think she knows from the way I act towards my father.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねお母さんにお話をしたら、何て言ってくれると、思いますか
dialogue.content: I see. If you were to talk to your mother, what do you think she would say?

dialogue.origin: んー、私のテンションによるかな、あんまりキレてる時は、しょーがないと思ってるかも
dialogue.content: Hmm, it would depend on my mood. If I'm really angry, she might just think there's nothing to be done.

dialogue.origin: 一度、お母さんに、お話をしてみては、いかがでしょうか
dialogue.content: How about trying to talk to your mother about it?

dialogue.origin: どんな風に、ですか？
dialogue.content: In what way?

dialogue.origin: お母さん、大事な話があるのですが、聴いてください。と言って、公園か、喫茶店で、お話ししてみましょう
dialogue.content: You could say, "Mom, I have something important to talk about. Could you please listen?" and then try talking to her at a park or a coffee shop.

dialogue.origin: そのほうが、しっかりとお話が出来ます
dialogue.content: That way, you'll be able to have a proper conversation.

dialogue.origin: いかがですか
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: キレてるときは、なかなかそうは切り出せそうもないのですが‥
dialogue.content: When I'm angry, I don't think I could bring it up like that...

dialogue.origin: 私も波があって
dialogue.content: I have my ups and downs, too.

dialogue.origin: そうでないときに、お話をしてみてくださいくるさんの波も、ご自身で、検討してみてくださいくるさんの、生活が、有意義になることを、心から、応援しています
dialogue.content: Please try talking to her when you're not feeling that way. Please also try to be aware of your own moods. I sincerely hope your life becomes more fulfilling.

dialogue.origin: どうですか、お話しできそうですか
dialogue.content: What do you think, does it sound like you could talk to her?

dialogue.origin: ↑いかがですか
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 落ち着いてる時、なら、、、
dialogue.content: When I'm calm, maybe...

dialogue.origin: そうですね。深呼吸して、ぜひ、試してみてください
dialogue.content: Yes. Take a deep breath and please give it a try.

dialogue.origin: 深呼吸ですね
dialogue.content: Deep breaths, okay.

dialogue.origin: 上手くいかなかったとき、何かあった時は、また、いらしてください。また、別の方法を、考えますね
dialogue.content: If it doesn't go well, or if anything comes up, please come back. We can think of another way together.

dialogue.origin: はいその時はお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, I will. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: くるさんの幸せを、心からお祈りしています
dialogue.content: I sincerely wish for your happiness, Kuru.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、来ていただき、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: これで、今日のカウンセリングを、終了しますありがとうございます
dialogue.content: This concludes today’s counseling session. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 今日は、本当に、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you so much for today.

dialogue.origin: おつかれさまでした。勉強になりました。ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time. This has been very helpful. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: お疲れ様でした
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time.

dialogue.origin: 終了ボタンを押しますね
dialogue.content: I'll press the end button now.
